metric_definitions.response_change: AC-off minus normal, averaged over held-out sequences and time bins per cell
metric_definitions.response_peak_latency: time from flash onset to each sequence's maximum absolute baseline deviation, then averaged per cell
metric_definitions.response_peak_magnitude: maximum absolute deviation from each sequence's mean pre-flash baseline, then averaged per cell
metric_definitions.temporal_rf: final-bin conditional RGC-logit Jacobian averaged over one recorded validation trial per held-out natural image

rf_artifact_identity.observed_history_context: recorded Bernoulli validation spike events with the model's causal one-bin RGC history shift
rf_artifact_identity.rf_estimand: final-bin conditional RGC-logit Jacobian averaged over one recorded validation trial per held-out natural image
rf_artifact_identity.temporal_rf_definition: signed sum of final-bin global RF over cone dimension

explicit_pathway_delay.meaning: bounded-learnable fractional pathway delays in ms

validation.rf_context: one recorded held-out trial per source image
